theme: Skia m151 and managed perf ports
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia milestone m151 and ports several hot color/text paths to managed C#.
highlights_body: It ports SKColor/SKColorF conversion and premultiply math to managed code, adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM support for .NET 11, and fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

bullets.detail: Bundles the Chrome m151 engine along with upstream bug-fix merges pulled in during the preview cycle.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and a preview-.NET WASM test job so exception-handling regressions are caught early.
SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks a native resource when constructing a subset image.
Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression introduced upstream.

bullets.lead: Managed color and text hot paths
bullets.detail: Ports SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply math to managed C#, and reads SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans, cutting P/Invoke overhead.
Removes per-call char[4] allocations in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, and makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding.
Optimizes SKColor hex parsing and adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads.
GRContextOptions no longer requires the unsafe modifier, simplifying consumer code that touches it.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped Skia to drop an unused SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition, alongside other build cleanups.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 finalized the Skia m151 upgrade and the managed color/text performance ports ahead of stable.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 landed the managed SKColorF conversion and premultiply ports, plus the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151.0 line with the Skia m151 update and the initial native-resource-leak fix in SKImage.

harfbuzz_summary: Removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse and makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding, reducing overhead in shaping-heavy text workloads.
